meta.title: 森游记第五集：在上海Citywalk像喝水一样容易丨BF丨50mm F2丨拍照姿势教学丨清新人像拍摄引导
meta.title_en: Mori's Travel Log Ep.5: Citywalk in Shanghai Is as Easy as Drinking Water

scenes.title_en: Opening: A Citywalk on a Rainy Day
scenes.context: 摄影师森华介绍本期：在上海两天拍两组图，遇到阴雨天没太多发挥空间，于是拍一组Citywalk。设备是适马BF加50mm F2镜头。语域：摄影教学口播，轻松开场。
sentences: 大家早中晚好，我是摄影师森华，本期Citywalk我们来到了上海。
Good morning, afternoon, or evening, everyone. I'm photographer Senhua, and in this Citywalk episode we're in Shanghai.
Good morning, afternoon, or evening（早中晚好，万能的打招呼）；photographer（摄影师）
不过遇到阴雨天，确实没有什么发挥空间，那就拍组Citywalk吧。
But with this overcast, rainy weather, there's not much room to show off — so let's shoot a Citywalk.
overcast, rainy weather（阴雨天）；no room to show off（没发挥空间）；shoot a Citywalk（拍一组Citywalk）
使用的设备是适马BF，镜头是适马50mm F2。
I'm using a Sigma BF with a Sigma fifty-millimeter F2 lens.
fifty-millimeter lens（50mm镜头）；F2（大光圈）
paraphrase: 没什么发挥空间 → no room to show off / not much to work with
no room to show off · not much to work with
拍一组Citywalk → shoot a Citywalk / do a street-walk photo set
shoot · do a photo set
scenes.speak: Good morning, afternoon, or evening, everyone. I'm photographer Senhua, and in this Citywalk episode we're in Shanghai. But with this overcast, rainy weather, there's not much room to show off — so let's shoot a Citywalk. I'm using a Sigma BF with a Sigma fifty-millimeter F2 lens.

scenes.title_cn: 姿势教学一：坐姿不要靠
scenes.context: 摄影师引导模特在朝阳路墙边坐姿：整个人坐上去不要有靠的感觉，膀子往后架着，头靠上去，手背在身后。语域：现场引导指令，短句频出。
sentences: 整个人坐上去，就是不要有靠的感觉。
Sit on it, but don't look like you're leaning on anything.
don't look like you're leaning（不要有靠的感觉）；sit on it（坐上去）
你的膀子往后这样架着，然后头靠在这个上面。
Prop your arms back like this, then rest your head on it.
prop your arms back（胳膊向后架）；rest your head on（把头靠在…上）
手背在后面，对，很好看。
Put your hands behind your back — yes, that looks great.
put your hands behind your back（手背在身后）；looks great（很好看）
paraphrase: 向后架着 → prop your arms back / push your elbows back
prop back · push back
很好看 → that looks great / very nice / stunning
looks great · stunning
scenes.speak: Sit on it, but don't look like you're leaning on anything. Prop your arms back like this, then rest your head on it. Put your hands behind your back — yes, that looks great.

scenes.title_cn: 姿势教学二：不锈钢墙与望远镜手势
scenes.title_en: Pose Two: The Steel Wall & the Binoculars
scenes.context: 模特蹲在不锈钢墙边做「手比望远镜」的姿势，摄影师指导蹲下、站位、轻轻躺下的角度。语域：摄影引导，动作指令。
sentences: 你蹲在这个不锈钢这儿，来个手比望远镜。
Squat by the stainless steel wall and make a binoculars gesture with your hands.
squat（蹲下）；a binoculars gesture（手比望远镜）
蹲下来再这样，站到这个位置吧。
Get down lower like this, then stand over here.
get down lower（再蹲低点）；stand over here（站到这边）
你从那个位置往我这儿走，3、2、1，走。
Walk toward me from that spot — three, two, one, go.
walk toward me（往我这边走）；three, two, one, go（3、2、1，走）
paraphrase: 蹲下来 → squat down / get down lower / crouch
squat down · crouch
往我这儿走 → walk toward me / walk my way
walk toward me · walk my way
scenes.speak: Squat by the stainless steel wall and make a binoculars gesture with your hands. Get down lower like this, then stand over here. Walk toward me from that spot — three, two, one, go.

scenes.title_cn: 借浇花壶：与路人互动的画面
scenes.context: 摄影师向叔叔借浇花壶给模特拍「浇花」画面，礼貌请求与道谢，运动相机在这之后自动关机，丢了部分素材。语域：中文礼貌口语+拍摄记录。
sentences: 叔叔，我可以借一下这个浇花壶拍张照吗？
Uncle, may I borrow this watering can for a photo?
borrow ... for a photo（借…拍张照）；watering can（浇花壶）
可以的，那我倒一点水。
Sure, let me pour a little water.
sure（可以的）；pour a little water（倒一点水）
在这个之后，运动相机就自动关机了，露了蛮多的素材。
Right after that, the action camera shut itself off, and we lost a lot of footage.
action camera（运动相机）；shut itself off（自动关机）；lose footage（丢素材）
paraphrase: 借一下…拍张照 → borrow ... for a photo / could I use ... to take a picture
borrow for · use to take
丢素材 → lose footage / missed a lot of shots
lose footage · miss shots
scenes.speak: Uncle, may I borrow this watering can for a photo? Sure, let me pour a little water. Right after that, the action camera shut itself off, and we lost a lot of footage.

scenes.title_en: Wrap-Up: Three, Two, One, Look Back
scenes.context: 最后一张图用「回头」的动作收尾，摄影师和嘉宾道别，约定下次见。语域：拍摄引导收尾，轻松道别。
sentences: Three, two, one — look back.
look back（回头看）；拍摄引导常用口令
谢谢叔叔。
Thank you, uncle.
感谢用语，中文礼貌语境
拜拜，下次见咯。
Bye-bye, see you next time.
see you next time（下次见）；轻松道别
paraphrase: 回头 → look back / glance over your shoulder
look back · glance over shoulder
下次见 → see you next time / catch you later
see you next time · catch you later
scenes.speak: Three, two, one — look back. Thank you, uncle. Bye-bye, see you next time.

practice: 开场介绍自己这期要拍什么
Hi everyone, I'm photographer Senhua, and today we're doing a Citywalk in Shanghai.
Sit on the wall, don't lean, prop your arms back and rest your head on it.
Excuse me, may I borrow your watering can for a photo?
Great shots today — bye, see you next time!
pitfalls: 「自动关机」是 shut itself off / auto shut down，不是 off itself（把 off 当动词是错的）。
Walk toward me / come over here.
walk to here 不自然，用 come over here 或 walk toward me。
I want to borrow a watering can take photo.
May I borrow your watering can to take a photo?
borrow ... to do / for ... 结构；两个动词不能直接堆叠。
That pose looks great / very nice.
形容「人好看/姿势好看」用 looks great / flattering；good-looking 通常修饰人而非姿势。
shifts: 引导模特只会说 stand here / sit here
用描述性口令：don't lean、prop your arms back、rest your head、get down lower
区分 overcast（阴天）、drizzly（毛毛雨）、sunny spells（间歇放晴）
按器材区分 action camera（运动相机）、prime lens（定焦）、wide aperture（大光圈）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：朝阳路墙→街边矮墙、世马→适马、BF→适马BF机身、露了蛮多→丢了不少素材 等
